profile.headline: User Experience and UI Designer/Director. Art Director, Web Designer, Web Developer
profile.summary: Over 20 years experience partnering with companies from startups to enterprises. I pair sharp and rapid execution skills and create complex and scalable products. My projects range from web design and development, to full-scale user experience and user interface design for complex visual systems. My technical expertise includes Figma, Figma Make, Wordpress, Adobe Creative Suite, WebFlow, Shopify, Sketch, and Claude Code. Furthermore, I have deep managerial experience, and excellent client service skills. Currently, I work and live in the Washington DC Metropolitan Area. In 2006, I graduated with a BFA from the Rhode Island School of Design.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: Design graphics for marthastewart.com. Design partner websites and skins, such as WeddingWire.com. Work closely with online editors, information architects, and Vice President of Online Media. Assist the Senior Art Director and collaborate on online ventures with Martha Stewart Television and Video, and Martha Stewart Radio. Create banner ads for varying promotions and offers. Translate print design to online design, and follow strict branding conventions. Design promotional graphics for merchandising including Martha Stewart Flowers, Martha Stewart Crafts, Martha Stewart Furniture, and Martha Stewart Everyday. Digital photo retouching and archiving. Design interactive features and modules, community portals, vendor micro sites, seasonal treatments, and Martha Stewart blogs.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: Design all aspects for independent school websites from the ground up. Includes home, interior, portal, intranet, and interactive pages able to cross all major browsers and platforms. Work closely with project managers, producers, developers, and clients. Also create additional design elements for clients with pre-existing branding. Create flexible designs that support dynamic content. Awarded the position of managing four designers in the client services department after demonstrating excellent client service and organizational skills. Delegate tasks, oversee designer progress, and mediate between designer and client.
